newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil May 23-June 22 Fipe inflation at 1.36 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil May 23-June 22 Fipe inflation at 1.36 pct.

text.p: Brazil's inflation as measured by the Economic Research Institute (Fipe) was 1.36 percent in the May 23-June 22 period versus 1.17 percent in the prior four-week period, a Fipe official said.
Fipe chief Juarez Rizzieri said a rise in bus and milk prices caused the acceleration in the price index, which measures inflation in the Sao Paulo area.
He expected inflation to end at 1.30 to 1.35 percent in June.
Rizzieri released the following breakdown of Fipe's weighted inflation index for May 23-June 22.
- Food 0.67 pct rise in the month
- Housing 2.09 pct rise in the month
- Transportation 1.85 pct rise in the month
- Personal expenses -0.12 pct drop in the month
- Clothing 3.83 pct rise in the month
- Health care 0.88 pct rise in the month
- Education 0.19 pct rise in the mont
The Fipe index is calculated by the University of Sao Paulo, which releases inflation figures weekly.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
